collector_control.long60-lean: process census disabled; whole-VM CPU and qdisc collection retained

setup_failures_before_noise.problem: Copied seed tree already contained target metadata directory; copied intended role metadata with directories allowed to exist. Existing overlays verified against intended stopped backing files.
Inherited guest capture directory name collided with prior run. New acquisition prefix long60 keeps old captures and separates new cases.

interpretation_limits: 70-second noise trials with60-second TCP; not continuous hours-long endurance.
Native Linux clients only; no GUI client or dynamic external-IP retest.
Host scheduling and full-system load remain part of this QEMU/WHPX lab.
Exit authenticates all VPN data; partial header admission is not peer authentication.
